environment: Windows; Node 24.22.1; Playwright 1.63.0 / Chromium 153.0.8010.12; Firefox 155.0 / WebKit 26.6 core flows; ja-JP; Asia/Tokyo; IAB 1280x720 and 320x800; Poppler 120 dpi; Python 3.12 / Pillow / pypdf
reviewer: NOEMA; AI code/UI/visual review on 2026-10-22; not a human usability study

default-page-quality.notes: Fresh frozen-source IAB reload and saved screenshot inspected. White paper, manuscript wrapping and setting tabs remain clear. Eleven changed reference images were individually reviewed with reasons and before/after hashes; zero changed-pixel contract retained. Full gate result recorded separately.

vertical-glyphs-and-spacing.notes: All main and excerpt pages inspected in nine independent Poppler contact sheets plus native foundation, A5 ruby/emphasis/Latin and hierarchical TOC views. No observed unintended clipping, overlap or mirroring in these fixtures. This is not complete JLREQ or arbitrary-glyph validation.

mobile-usability.notes: Frozen-source 320x800 manuscript, export and focused JSON save views captured and inspected. Close/save/start controls fit; original manuscript remains until explicit continuation. Real phones, software keyboards, actual Safari, assistive-technology and human usability remain untested.

export-appearance.notes: All 35 current-source physical pages from seven primary and two excerpt PDFs rendered independently and inspected. Hierarchical TOC indentation, original excerpt folios, intentional blanks, external pages and spread halves are coherent. Machine image/navigation checks are separate. Raster RGB only; no PDF/X, CMYK or embedded/searchable-text guarantee.

local-first.notes: Save confirmation and retry share the same local writer; no second book model or remote manuscript service. Existing restoration, conflict, quota and source-preservation checks remain enabled. Official vendored PDF.js/fflate packages have integrity and license records. Publication excludes output, runtime manuscripts/assets and local storage; release/tag creation is not performed.
